title: Your first hospital job: state and territory RMO recruitment
metaTitle: RMO recruitment 2027: apply direct, by state
metaDescription: On the Standard Pathway, hospitals recruit your first RMO/JHO/SHO job directly through annual state and territory campaigns. Which 2027 campaigns are still open, which have closed, and official links.
keywords: first hospital job IMG Standard Pathway
summaryMarkdown: On the [Standard Pathway](/pathways/standard), a common misconception is that a recruitment agency can secure your first resident medical officer (RMO, also called JHO or SHO) job in Australia. In reality, most hospitals recruit these roles directly through their annual campaigns and recruitment processes. [[cite:direct-recruitment]] If you are an AMC CAT MCQ candidate, the best move is to apply directly to the relevant state and territory campaigns.

sections.heading: Apply directly to the state and territory campaigns
sections.bodyMarkdown:
Most public hospitals fill RMO, junior house officer and senior house officer positions through their own annual recruitment campaigns, not through agencies. [[cite:direct-recruitment]] For AMC MCQ candidates, focus on applying directly to the relevant state and territory campaigns. Each state and territory runs its own process, with its own application portal and closing dates.

Once you have established Australian clinical experience, a recruiter can often add value in helping you navigate future career opportunities. For doctors who have completed the AMC clinical examination, or who are progressing through the [Competent Authority Pathway](/pathways/competent-authority), agency support is available earlier.

sections.heading: 2027 RMO campaign status (as at 5 October 2026)
sections.bodyMarkdown:
Applications for most 2027 clinical year campaigns have now closed, and offers are being made. As at 5 October 2026 the openings still ahead of you are the New South Wales second round, which is open now, Queensland's open round for remaining vacancies from 9 November 2026 and South Australia's late vacancy management from 22 October 2026. If you are planning for the 2028 clinical year instead, the next cycle opens from around April 2027.

| State or territory | Status | Key dates | Official campaign |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Queensland | Applications closed, offers under way | Closed 29 June 2026; SHO and JHO offers 28 September to 21 October 2026; re-preference round 23 to 26 October; round 3 open round for remaining vacancies from 9 November 2026 | [Queensland Health RMO and Registrar campaign](https://www.careers.health.qld.gov.au/medical-careers/resident-medical-officer-rmo-and-registrar-campaign) |
| Western Australia | Closed | Ran 25 May to 22 June 2026; separate midyear campaign opens in January for August starts | [MedCareersWA, Resident Medical Officers](https://medcareerswa.health.wa.gov.au/resident-medical-officers) |
| South Australia | Closed, late vacancies ahead | Expressions of interest closed 1 July 2026; offer rounds 17 September to 8 October 2026; late vacancy management from 22 October 2026 until 1 February 2027 | [SA MET, PGY2 and Beyond recruitment](https://samet.org.au/postgraduate-year-2-and-beyond-recruitment/) |
| Northern Territory | Expressions of interest | No fixed 2027 campaign window is published; apply through the NT Government jobs site, separately for the Top End and Central Australia | [Health Jobs NT, RMO/HMO](https://healthjobs.nt.gov.au/explore-health-sectors/medical/rmohmo) |
| Tasmania | Closed | Ran 25 May to 22 June 2026; the 2027 RMO year starts 11 January 2027 | [Tasmanian Health, statewide RMO applications](https://www.health.tas.gov.au/careers/career-options/medical-careers/2027-statewide-resident-medical-officer-applications) |
| New South Wales | Second round open now | Main round ran 14 July to 4 August 2026; second round opened 29 September 2026, with closing dates set by each advertised position | [NSW Health JMO recruitment](https://www.health.nsw.gov.au/jmo/Pages/job-seekers.aspx) |
| ACT | Closed, offers under way | RMO and Service SRMO advertised 31 August to 27 September 2026; first round offers September to November 2026, subsequent offers November 2026 to January 2027 | [Canberra Health Services JMO careers](https://www.canberrahealthservices.act.gov.au/careers/junior-medical-officer-careers) |
| Victoria | Match closed, results out | PGY2 match ran 27 July to 21 August 2026, results published 23 September 2026; hospitals also recruit individually | [PMCV, the Match](https://www.pmcv.com.au) |

Confirm every date on the official page. Campaigns, rounds and closing dates change each year, and some jurisdictions run more than one round.

claims.text: Australian public hospitals recruit resident medical officers (RMOs, also called JHOs or SHOs) directly through annual state and territory campaigns and recruitment processes, rather than through agencies.

Queensland Health's 2027 RMO and Registrar campaign ran from 1 June 2026 and closed at 3pm on Monday 29 June 2026; offers for senior and junior house officers run from 28 September to 21 October 2026, followed by a re-preference round from 23 to 26 October and a third, open round for remaining vacancies from Monday 9 November 2026.

Western Australia's centralised RMO and Service Medical Registrar recruitment for January 2027 commencement opened 25 May 2026 and closed 22 June 2026; a separate midyear campaign opens in January for positions commencing in August.

South Australia recruits Postgraduate Year 2 and beyond (RMO) doctors through a centralised SA MET expression of interest process that opens each June; expressions of interest for the 2027 clinical year closed on 1 July 2026, offer rounds ran from 17 September to 8 October 2026, and late vacancy management runs from 22 October 2026 until 1 February 2027.

The Northern Territory runs an annual RMO recruitment cycle with separate applications for the Top End and Central Australia, and its RMO page now directs applicants to submit expressions of interest through the NT Government jobs site rather than publishing a fixed campaign window.
Tasmania's statewide RMO applications for the 2027 clinical year opened 25 May 2026 and closed 22 June 2026, with the resident medical officer year commencing Monday 11 January 2027.

New South Wales recruits Junior Medical Officers through a statewide eRecruit system in rounds; the 2027 main round was advertised from 14 July 2026 and closed 4 August 2026, and a second round opened on 29 September 2026, with closing dates set by each advertised position.

In the ACT, Canberra Health Services advertises Junior Medical Officer positions by stream for the 2027 intake, with RMO and Service SRMO positions advertised from 31 August to 27 September 2026; all 2027 streams have now closed, with first round offers from September to November 2026 and subsequent offer rounds from November 2026 to January 2027.

In Victoria, hospitals recruit RMOs individually, with the Postgraduate Medical Council of Victoria administering the computer-match allocation for many programs; its PGY2 match ran from 27 July to 21 August 2026, and results were published on 23 September 2026.

faq.question: Do I need a recruitment agency to get my first RMO job in Australia?
faq.answerMarkdown: Generally no. Public hospitals recruit RMO, JHO and SHO roles directly through annual state and territory campaigns, so AMC MCQ candidates should apply directly to the relevant campaigns. A recruiter can add more value later, once you have Australian clinical experience.

faq.question: Which 2027 campaigns are still open?
faq.answerMarkdown: As at 5 October 2026, the New South Wales second round is open now, with closing dates set by each advertised position. Still ahead: South Australia's late vacancy management (from 22 October 2026) and Queensland's open round for remaining vacancies (from 9 November 2026). Western Australia, South Australia, Tasmania, the ACT and the Victorian PMCV PGY2 match have all closed, and offers are being made. Always confirm the exact date on the official campaign page, as these change.

faq.question: I have missed the 2027 campaigns. What now?
faq.answerMarkdown: Later rounds still fill vacancies: the New South Wales second round is open now, South Australia manages late vacancies from 22 October 2026 until 1 February 2027, Queensland runs an open round from 9 November 2026, and Western Australia runs a midyear campaign that opens in January for August starts. The Northern Territory takes expressions of interest through the NT Government jobs site year round. Otherwise, plan for the 2028 clinical year, where campaigns start opening from around April 2027.

faq.question: How does Victoria work?
faq.answerMarkdown: Victorian hospitals recruit RMOs individually rather than through a single statewide campaign, and the Postgraduate Medical Council of Victoria runs the computer-match allocation for many programs. Its PGY2 match ran from 27 July to 21 August 2026, and results were published on 23 September 2026.

faq.question: When can a recruiter actually help?
faq.answerMarkdown: Once you have established Australian clinical experience, recruiters can often help you navigate future career opportunities. For doctors who have completed the AMC clinical examination, or who are progressing through the Competent Authority Pathway, agency support is available earlier.
